content:
GOAL: freeze the scoring plan and audit the shared evidence before scoring nine proposals on rubric-2026-10-v1.
READ: the nine proposal texts (behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts, BRANCHCURV-SID, SUCC-TAN-RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, GEO_REPAIR, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ) and the shared frozen bundle items E4-E11 that recur in every bundle id.
OBSERVED: all nine bundles carry the same OBSERVED block: E4 data contract; E5 successor-entropy stratification (top-1 mass 0.4375 in bin 1 vs 0.0543 in bin 5, Spearman -0.973, distinct successors 2.72 -> 41.41); E6 width-20 beam survival ledger (l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, plus gold-prefix survival depth 1/2/3/4); E7 teacher-forced NLL per position showing l1_br at 0/0/0/9.03 vs resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05; E8 first-level capacity ceiling (share of canonical pairs sharing one of K clusters 0.3106/0.2164/0.1547/0.0822 for K=16/32/64/256); E9 cohort-profile signal 0.9291 vs 0.8871; E10 coverage (118315 edges, mean out-degree 5.4526); E11 baseline SID same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
PLACED AT: the nine proposal bundles (sha ids 049d663f765dd9c6, 793ad1b98a447ed6, d05a69f10df0b176, 50a5519306326a02, 30c1719765864a9d, fff91d61a8162b9b, c671300940bb9492, a56f1901261e9aa4, bd8bbcbdc448cf32).
REASONING: the ledger matters twice. (a) every previously measured arm is below 0.065 (best 0.06363) so the bar is above all prior measurements; (b) the ledger names already-measured mechanism families (successor_entropy, successor_geodesic_coarse, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2, tangent_successor_residual) which three of the nine proposals re-enter. Behaviour evidence will be scored 4 only where the proposal's own statistic is the measured one (entropy/top-1 mass), 3 where the statistic is constructed on transitions but unmeasured, 2 where the named problem (full-SID collisions) is not in the bundle at all.
OPEN: no per-proposal geometry audit yet; no scores yet.

GOAL: settle the geometry-reduction argument that drives geometry_necessity for the curvature-field proposals, and re-check the algebra before using it as a counterexample.
READ: E12/E13/E14 of BRANCHCURV-SID and KAPPA_BRANCH (per-code kappa_k and per-pair harmonic-mean kbar_ik inside the Poincare assignment distance), and the ledger rows in E6.
OBSERVED: both proposals score codes with d_kappa(u,e_k)^2 (BRANCHCURV, divided by a frozen tau) or with the curvature-k bar distance plus a curvature-k commitment L_c = beta*d_kbar(p(r),p(c_{k*}))^2 (KAPPA_BRANCH).
REASONING (corrected after re-deriving, this supersedes any earlier intuition that these are genuine metric changes): for the Poincare ball, d_k(u,v) = (1/sqrt(k)) * arcosh(1 + 2k||u-v||^2/((1-k||u||^2)(1-k||v||^2))). The factor (1/sqrt(k)) is a positive constant per (i,k) pair and arcosh is strictly increasing, so argmin over k of d_k(u,e_k)^2 is argmin over k of k*||u-e_k||^2/((1-k||u||^2)(1-k||e_k||^2)) - i.e. a per-code multiplicative weight on the squared Euclidean distance. When k varies only through the code index (BRANCHCURV) or through one fixed item and the code index (KAPPA_BRANCH), the "curvature field" is exactly a per-code gated Euclidean distance: no residual hyperbolic property (exponential volume growth, tree-likeness) survives, because that property needs one curvature shared by the whole candidate set. A matched Euclidean control (per-code weight/temperature on a Euclidean distance) reproduces the assignment exactly.
PLACED AT: BRANCHCURV-SID E12/E13/E14 and KAPPA_BRANCH E12/E13/E14, with the numeric band from the clamps (kappa_k in [0.25k0,4k0]; kbar in [1,2]).
OPEN: whether the softmax temperature tau (BRANCHCURV) adds anything a Euclidean temperature does not - it does not, so the reduction covers the soft-assignment version too.

GOAL: score proposal 1, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts.
READ: its E1/E2/E3 (top-8 directed successor counts, forward window 5, popularity-debiased), E12/E13 (Poincare c=1, log_a/exp_a, geodesic residual chain), the specification and cost block, against E5/E6/E8/E10/E11.
OBSERVED: behaviour statistic is measured with coverage (E5 gives per-bin item counts, E10 gives 118315 edges and mean out-degree 5.4526); the chart clamp is |a_i| <= 0.5s and s is the frozen median encoder norm; the ledger's Euclidean arms (0.06207, 0.06233) beat every curved arm (0.05500, 0.05500, 0.05122, 0.05463).
SCORES: behavior 4, geometry 3, novelty 2, downstream 4, falsifiability 4, implementability 4, exploration 2.
PLACED AT: bundle 049d663f765dd9c6, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE. Objection: with |a_i| <= 0.5s the conformal leverage is bounded, so the chart is close to a Euclidean re-centring, and the ledger's Euclidean arms already lead. Counterexample: two items sharing one anchor a are separated by a fixed positive conformal factor (1-|a|^2)^2/4 at that base, so the factor cannot reorder level-1 codes; with |a| <= 0.5s it varies by at most (1/0.75)^2 = 1.78 across anchors.
OPEN: novelty beyond the mechanism names in E6 is UNKNOWN; the bounded check is to read the ledger rows for successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 and tangent_successor_residual and diff their residual step against log_{a_i}(p_i).

GOAL: score proposal 2, BRANCHCURV-SID.
READ: E1/E2/E3 (per-code successor-branching entropy from rows of items assigned to code k, EMA 0.9, freeze at epoch 500), E12/E13/E14 (kappa_k = k0*exp(H_k-Hbar) clamped to [0.25k0,4k0], logits -d_{kappa_k}(u_i,e_k)^2/tau, tau frozen at epoch 0).
OBSERVED: E5 supports branching heterogeneity strongly (top-1 mass 0.4375 -> 0.0543, Spearman -0.973, support 2.8 -> 44.3), so the input statistic is real and audited; but the specification never fixes the space of the codebook vectors e_k (u_i is exp-mapped with k0 while e_k is used raw as the second argument of d_{kappa_k}) and it defines q_i = softmax(l_i) without wiring q_i into any loss, while claiming the loss is "only assignment distances and code usage".
SCORES: behavior 4, geometry 2, novelty 2, downstream 3, falsifiability 2, implementability 3, exploration 1.
PLACED AT: bundle 793ad1b98a447ed6, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE on the letter of the contract (behaviour entropy enters the assignment distance inside the quantizer), but marginal on implementability. Objection: per-code curvature scales the distance by a per-code constant, so it is a per-code temperature, and the codebook space and the soft-assignment wiring are undefined. Counterexample: d_k(u,v) = (1/sqrt(k))d_1(sqrt(k)u,sqrt(k)v) and argmin of its square equals argmin of k||u-e_k||^2/((1-k||u||^2)(1-k||e_k||^2)); with k in a 4x band that is a Euclidean per-code weight, so a per-code temperature in a Euclidean softmax reproduces the assignment.
OPEN: novelty vs the sibling KAPPA_BRANCH (same entropy-to-curvature map, index changed from item to code) is a routine variation; whether the ledger already contains a per-code metric variant is UNKNOWN - bounded check is the ledger's successor_entropy row (E6 0.05122) plus its codebook entry.

GOAL: score proposal 3, SUCC-TAN-RQ, and verify the residual-chain equations symbolically rather than by reading.
READ: its specification (t_i from the 32 most frequent successors, eta = d_code/median||t_i||, b_i^1 = exp_0(log_0 u_i + eta t_i), c_1 = argmin d(b^1,e_k), xi_1 = log_{e_{c1}}(b^1) - log_{e_{c1}}(e_{c1}), b^2 = exp_{e_{c1}}(xi_1), and so on for L=3), against E6/E7.
OBSERVED: substitute log_e(e) = 0, so xi_1 = log_{e_{c1}}(b^1), hence b^2 = exp_{e_{c1}}(log_{e_{c1}}(b^1)) = b^1 by the identity exp_x(log_x(y)) = y; therefore c_2 = c_1 and, inductively, c_3 = c_1. Every item gets SID (k1,k1,k1) and the chain has effective depth 1, while the loss term d(s_i,u_hat)^2 still pulls the single codeword to one third of the tangent offset. Separately, E6 lists tangent_successor_residual at recall@10 0.05500 with E7 NLL 4.00/3.17/1.67/0.29 - the same mechanism name, already measured.
SCORES: behavior 3, geometry 2, novelty 1, downstream 2, falsifiability 2, implementability 2, exploration 0.
PLACED AT: bundle d05a69f10df0b176, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E7 E10 E12 E13 E14.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE on form (behaviour tangent shift, fixed-k exp/log, one pathway, three switches, equations) but the specification does not compute what it claims. Objection: the residual step is the identity, so the mechanism cannot produce depth-2/3 prefixes, which is exactly where the ledger loses recall (E6 gold prefix alive at depth 2/3 is 0.829/0.161 for l1_br_euclid). Counterexample: as above, exp_x(log_x(y)) = y applied once.
OPEN: whether a corrected version (subtracting the codeword in the tangent frame before the exp) would be distinct from tangent_successor_residual - it would be a rename, so the novelty read stands.

GOAL: score proposal 4, GEOPFX-SID.
READ: its specification (LCP_ij from SIDs, g_ij = exp_0(sum of shared prefix code logs), geodesic segment gamma, delta = min over 12 golden-section steps, L_geo = mean w_ij*delta^2/d^2, weight fixed at 1, pairs with LCP=0 skipped) against E6/E8/E11.
OBSERVED: E11 gives the baseline same-first-prefix rate 0.0907 (permuted null 0.067), so at initialisation almost no pair has LCP>=1; E6 shows the recall is lost at depth 2/3 (gold prefix alive 0.829/0.161 for l1_br_euclid) while depth-1 survival is 1.000.
SCORES: behavior 3, geometry 3, novelty 3, downstream 3, falsifiability 3, implementability 3, exploration 3.
PLACED AT: bundle 50a5519306326a02, items E2 E3 E6 E8 E11 E12 E13 E14.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE - behaviour counts and a hyperbolic point-to-geodesic-segment distance sit in a single term that acts on the codebook/encoder, so removing either changes it. Objection: the term is exactly zero and has exactly zero gradient while LCP=0, so it cannot bootstrap prefix sharing; it is a refinement applied after pigeonhole forces codes together, and its normalisation gives a length-1 and a length-3 prefix the same weight. Counterexample: at step 0 take any of the 2048 sampled pairs; no two items share a first token, so every LCP_ij = 0, L_geo = 0 exactly and dL_geo/de = 0, so the first steps are bit-identical to the baseline.
OPEN: whether the betweenness target is distinct from the ledger's successor_geodesic_coarse is UNKNOWN at the level of detail given; bounded check is the ledger entry's target (coarse successor geodesic vs segment residual).

GOAL: score proposal 5, GEO-SHELL-RQ.
READ: its E1/E2/E3 (symmetrised transition graph, L-level Leiden/normalised-cut community tree, leaf mass B_g, r = (N-B)/(N+B), rho = (2/sqrt c)artanh(sqrt c r), Karcher mean direction, shell projection onto [rho-delta, rho+delta]) against E5/E8/E9.
OBSERVED: the bundle measures successor entropy (E5) and successor cohort profiles (E9, 0.9291 vs 0.8871 with 64 cohorts, mean profile entropy 1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts) but contains no measured community tree, no measured leaf mass and no measured disagreement between content and behaviour partitions; the shell half-width delta is never specified.
SCORES: behavior 3, geometry 2, novelty 3, downstream 2, falsifiability 2, implementability 3, exploration 3.
PLACED AT: bundle 30c1719765864a9d, items E2 E3 E5 E8 E9 E10 E12 E13 E14 E15.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE (behaviour leaf mass sets the radius of a curved atom inside the quantizer). Objection: the radius map is monotone, so a Euclidean shell reproduces the partition, and the radius is invisible to the Stage-3 generator, which only sees token ids - the claim that a large radius makes a token predictable from a short history has no stated channel. Counterexample: B_g1 > B_g2 implies r_g1 > r_g2 implies rho_g1 > rho_g2 for any strictly increasing map, and artanh is strictly increasing on [0,1), so the curved map cannot change which community is further out; a Euclidean shell radius r with width tanh-based delta gives the identical partition.
OPEN: delta unspecified is the one specification gap that also blocks a one-run implementation without an extra choice.

GOAL: score proposal 6, GYRO-TARGET-RQ.
READ: its E1/E2/E3 (successor set S_i, c_i = top-1 mass, eta_i = c_i/(1+c_i) in [0,1/2], b_i = exp_{p_i}(eta_i*mean log_{p_i}(sg p_j)), reconstruction loss d_c(phat_i,b_i)^2), E15 matched Euclidean control, E16 geometry-operator sanity pass.
OBSERVED: c_i is exactly the measured top-1 successor mass of E5 (0.4375 in the lowest entropy quintile down to 0.0543 in the highest), so the behavioural scalar is measured with auditable per-bin item counts; E16 confirms the exp/log round-trip; E8 shows only 8.2% of canonical pairs share one of 256 level-1 clusters, so the level-1 partition is already the binding constraint.
SCORES: behavior 4, geometry 3, novelty 2, downstream 2, falsifiability 2, implementability 4, exploration 2.
PLACED AT: bundle fff91d61a8162b9b, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E8 E10 E12 E13 E14 E15 E16.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE (behaviour moves the reconstruction target inside the curved ball; removing eta or the exp/log changes the target and hence the codes). Objection: the mechanism deliberately merges items with the same successor set into one code, but Stage 3 emits one item per SID, so merged-away items become unreachable and the shift trades reachability for prefix predictability without bounding the trade. Counterexample: two distinct items i,j with S_i = S_j = {k} and c_i = c_j = 1 have eta = 1/2 and both targets on the geodesic from their own point to p_k; if p_i,p_j are mutually close the level-1 code is shared and the distinct-SID count drops by one while the generator's target set is unchanged.
OPEN: the "one item per SID" premise is taken from the sibling GEO_REPAIR statement and is consistent with the beam accounting in E6, but the bundle does not state the dedup rule; bounded check is the Stage-2 SID table's item-per-SID multiplicity.

GOAL: score proposal 7, KAPPA_BRANCH.
READ: E1/E2 (deduplicated transition counts, add-one smoothing, H_i, h_i = H_i/log(|S_i|+1), kappa_i = kappa0(1+h_i), kappa0 = 1), E12/E13/E14 (harmonic-mean pair curvature kbar in [1,2], p_kappa(w) = tanh(sqrt k||w||)/(sqrt k||w||)w, d_kappa, commitment 0.25*d_kbar^2, straight-through codebooks).
OBSERVED: the behavioural input is the measured entropy signal of E5 (strongly supported, Spearman -0.973, per-bin coverage), so behaviour evidence is high; but the curvature is per pair, so no single curvature is shared by the candidate set, and E6 shows the Euclidean arms (0.06207, 0.06233) above all curved arms.
SCORES: behavior 4, geometry 2, novelty 2, downstream 3, falsifiability 3, implementability 3, exploration 1.
PLACED AT: bundle c671300940bb9492, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E8 E10 E12 E13 E14.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE. Objection: by making curvature per pair the proposal gives up the global negative curvature that produces exponential volume growth - the property the motivation invokes - and no Euclidean arm is defined. Counterexample: for fixed k, d_k(u,v) = (1/sqrt k)arcosh(1 + 2k||u-v||^2/((1-k||u||^2)(1-k||v||^2))); arcosh strictly increasing and 1/sqrt(kbar_ik) a positive constant for fixed i imply argmin_k d_kbar_ik(p_i,c_k) = argmin_k kbar_ik||p_i-c_k||^2/((1-kbar_ik||p_i||^2)(1-kbar_ik||c_k||^2)), a per-code weighted Euclidean distance with no hyperbolic content left.
OPEN: the specification also leaves p(c_k) undefined (which curvature maps the codebook point), which is the dimensional gap an implementer must close.

GOAL: score proposal 8, GEO_REPAIR.
READ: its E1/E2/E3 (training in-degree, successor sets, full-SID groups, representative by in-degree, level-3 (else level-2) reassignment by min Poincare distance to the successor Frechet mean), E12/E13/E14, E15.
OBSERVED: the bundle contains no measured full-SID collision count and no measured unreachability share; E8 measures cluster sharing (0.0822 at K=256) and E11 measures same-first-prefix 0.0907, neither of which is a collision statistic; the "free capacity" of a candidate code is never defined.
SCORES: behavior 2, geometry 2, novelty 3, downstream 3, falsifiability 3, implementability 3, exploration 4.
PLACED AT: bundle a56f1901261e9aa4, items E1 E2 E3 E6 E8 E10 E11 E12 E13 E14 E15.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE but marginal: the encoder, loss and codebooks stay Euclidean and untouched, so behaviour and geometry enter only a post-hoc relabelling of the colliding tail; the curved operation is in the assignment decision, not in any training computation. Objection: the Poincare criterion is radially dominated when the successor mean is near the origin, so the argmin degenerates. Counterexample: with m near 0, d_P(m,c) ~ 2 artanh(||c||) is essentially independent of the direction of m, so the rule picks the candidate of smallest radius for every item whose successor set is diffuse; direction cannot override a radial gap of more than 2(artanh(rho2)-artanh(rho1)) because the angular term is bounded by the same artanh at each radius.
OPEN: the collision premise is UNKNOWN and would be resolved by counting the multiplicity of items per 3-token SID in the frozen Stage-2 SID table.

GOAL: score proposal 9, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ.
READ: E1/E2/E3 (PMI-adjusted directed transition mass aggregated onto consecutive-level codebook pairs M_l, built once before training), E12/E13/E14 (Lorentz model, trainable rho clamped [-1.5,1.5], geodesic log/exp residual quantiser, future-cone hinge with 0.1 weight and margin m = 0.1*median(-<Delta,Delta>_L)), and the cost claim.
OBSERVED: at level 1 the code pair mass is thin by construction (E8: only 8.2% of canonical pairs share one of 256 clusters, so most of the 256x256 M_1 entries are empty); the hinge margin m is initialised from the median at rho=0 and then frozen while rho is trainable; the cone ordering on the hyperboloid is a global causal relation, so it is well defined between any two centroids.
SCORES: behavior 3, geometry 3, novelty 4, downstream 4, falsifiability 4, implementability 3, exploration 4.
PLACED AT: bundle bd8bbcbdc448cf32, items E2 E3 E5 E6 E8 E10 E12 E13 E14.
RESULT: IN_SCOPE (PMI transition mass and a Lorentz cone order act on the same per-level centroids that the geodesic quantiser emits, so removing M or the curvature changes the codes). Objection: M_l is a matrix over level-l codebook indices and cannot be built "once before training" unless it is built from an arbitrary initial assignment, so either it is stale as soon as the codebooks move or it must be rebuilt (against the frozen-cost claim). Counterexample (dimensional): on the hyperboloid <x,x>_L = -1/c^2, so <Delta,Delta>_L scales as 1/c^2; with rho moving 0 -> 0.69 (c: 1 -> 2) every inner product shrinks by 4 while m stays fixed, so a configuration at <Delta,Delta>_L = -m/2 that violated the hinge at c=1 satisfies it at c=2 without any change of code geometry.
OPEN: whether a curvature-normalised margin (m/c^2) restores the invariance is the bounded check; as written the constraint strength is controlled by the parameter it is meant to couple to.
